This Criminal Original Petition has been filed to call for the records pertaining to the S.C.No.301 of 2013 on the file of the III Additional District and Sessions Court, Pattukkottai and quash the same as M.Karikalan vs State Rep.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
By on 13 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138623499/
1 against the petitioner.

2. The case of the prosecution is that on 15.09.2005 at 10.15 am, PW-1 along with the deceased viz.,
Karthick @ Karthickeyan travelled in the bike bearing Regn.No.TN 49 K 1698 and at that time, the accused persons intercepted and committed the murder of the deceased.

On receiving the complaint, a case in Crime No.420 of 2005 for the offences under Sections 147, 148, 120(b), 302 IPC r/w. 149 IPC and Section 3(1) of TNPPDL Act r/w. Section 149 IPC has been reggistered and on completion of investigation, charge sheet was filed before the learned Judicial Magistrate,
Pattukkottai in PRC.No.82 of 2008.

Subsequently, the case was committed to the learned III Additional District and Sessions Court, Pattukkottai and the same was taken cognizance in S.C.No.524 of 2008 and S.C.No.239 of 2009 as against the accused Nos.1, 3 to 8 and 10 respectively,
against the petitioner this case was split up, since the petitioner was absconded.

entities.text: III Additional District and Sessions Court, Pattukkottai
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Subsequently, the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Crl.O.P(MD).No.13860 of 2020 petitioner was surrendered the case was taken on file in S.C.No.301 of 2013 on the file of the III Additional District and Sessions Court, Pattukkottai and warrant was recalled in the year 2013 for the alleged offence under Sections 147, 148, 341, 302 r/w. 149 IPC and Sections 120(b) and 109 IPC.
3.

entities.text: III Additional District and Sessions Court, Pattukkottai
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that the accused persons who are all faced trial in S.C.No.524 of 2008 and S.C.No.239 of 2008 have been convicted by the order, dated 21.10.2020 for the alleged offence under Sections 148, 341, 302 IPC and sentenced to undergo life imprisonment.

Aggrieved over the order of conviction, they have preferred an appeal before this Court in Crl.A. (MD)Nos. 395 and 396 of 2010 and the same was allowed by the Division Bench of this Court on 27.06.2012 by acquitting all the accused persons.

He would further submit that PW-1 eye witness cannot be believed as eye witness and also he has not supported the prosecution case,
but, the prosecution not treated him as hostile.
Other eye witnesses viz., PW.2, PW.20 and PW-14 are turned as hostile.
Further, the recovery from the accused persons also disbelieved by this Court in the above said appeal filed by the co-accused and acquitted all the accused persons.

As https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Crl.O.P(MD).No.13860 of 2020 per the averments in the final report, similar and same charges have been framed as against the petitioner and hence, the benefit of the above said Judgment can be extended to this petitioner also, since this petitioner is also standing on the same footing.
In support of his contention he has also relied on the Judgments of this Court reported in 2007(1) LW (Crl.) 514 and 2011(3) MWN (Cr.) 124 and prays for allowing this Criminal Original Petition.

4. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the first respondent Police would submit that the co-accused were already acquitted as per the Division Bench Judgment of this Court, dated 27.06.2012 made in Crl.A.(MD)Nos. 395 and 396 of 2010.

5. Heard the learned counsel appearing on either side and perused the materials available on record.
6.

Since the charges framed against the petitioner and the co-accused are one and the same, the Division Bench Judgment of this Court, dated 27.06.2012 made in Crl.A.(MD)Nos. 395 and 396 of 2010, relied on by the learned counsel for the petitioner is squarely applicable https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Crl.O.P(MD).No.13860 of 2020 to the facts of the present case.
M.Karikalan vs State Rep.

By on 13 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138623499/
2
Following the same, this Court is inclined to allow this petition 7.

Accordingly, this Criminal Original Petition is allowed and the proceeding in S.C.No.301 of 2013 on the file of the III Additional District and Sessions Court, Pattukkottai is hereby quashed as against the petitioner.
